dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent elliptical 'O' and 'C' structures are visible along the dorsal ridge. These feature sharp pixel gradients transitioning from a high-intensity light-gray perimeter to a low-intensity dark-gray interior. Edge geometry ranges from closed circles to open-ended crescents with irregular boundary segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-gray pixel clusters is concentrated in the central lateral region. These clusters lack an internal gradient and exhibit irregular, asymmetrical shapes with high core pixel concentration interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary group of four high-intensity blobs creates a linear chain-like geometric alignment extending from the upper mid-body toward the ventral edge at approximately a 45-degree angle.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'chain-link' overlapping pattern of light-toned annuli is observed in the mid-dorsal transition zone where multiple circular structures intersect.
